products.name: NIVIS LABS UV BEST Sunscreen Gel (SPF 50 PA++++)
products.subtitle: Enriched with 1% Hyaluronic Acid, Cetiol CC, and Niacinamide, it delivers deep hydration, soothes hot skin, and helps control sweat while actively preventing heat rashes. Its advanced broad-spectrum defense shield blocks intense UV radiation, keeping your skin safe, cool, and radiant all day long. Suitable for all skin types.
